assets.label: Pre-facade residential construction illustration
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Construction draw financing marketing illustration showing a compact residential build before exterior facade installation.
Primary request: Generate a standalone monochrome architectural construction illustration for a construction draw financing website. Use the reference crop only for composition and subject: a compact narrow residential infill build, roughly three storeys plus lower level, at rough framing and sheathing stage before exterior facade installation. Preserve the warm off-white paper field, refined black ink linework, graphite wash, open framed window bays, temporary stairs, raw sheathing, temporary guardrails, modest lumber stacks, and small residential scale. No final facade materials: no brick, no stone, no siding, no finished windows, no finished entry door, no polished landscaping. Avoid tower cranes, high-rise construction, heavy equipment, workers, cars, UI text, labels, logos, progress timeline elements, watermarks, and collage layouts.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate as a clean standalone rectangular image asset.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: finished facade, brick cladding, stone cladding, siding, final glazing, finished front door, high-rise, crane, excavator, workers, cars, text, watermark, collage
